title: VIVEKTA
subtitle: The Journey
note: Source of truth for the film and the archive. Edit this file, not the code. Place names on the globe are HTML, so name/subtitle/caption use correct spelling everywhere - Alesund is written Ålesund, Tromso is written Tromsø.

stops.name: Cleo County, Noida
stops.subtitle: Home
stops.caption: Where it began — a one o'clock cab to the airport, with the whole of November still ahead.

stops.name: Delhi Airport
stops.subtitle: Terminal 1
stops.caption: IndiGo, 06:40. Two large bags, two small, and a long way north.

stops.name: Istanbul
stops.subtitle: IGA · layover
stops.caption: Four hours between two continents. Landed 11:15, left again at 15:20.

stops.name: Oslo
stops.subtitle: Sørengkaia
stops.caption: Down at 17:20, then the airport train, then an Uber, then a flat on the water at Sørengkaia. Dinner that night at Fiskeriet Bjørvika, twelve minutes' walk away.

stops.name: Myrdal
stops.subtitle: Bergen Railway
stops.caption: Oslo S at 08:25, Myrdal at 13:04. Four and a half hours across the mountains, and a one-minute walk from track 1 to track 11.

stops.name: Flåm
stops.subtitle: Flåmsbana
stops.caption: Fifty minutes and eight hundred and sixty-five metres down, on one of the steepest railways in the world. 13:15 at the top, 14:05 at the bottom, the fjord waiting at the end of it.

stops.name: Gudvangen
stops.subtitle: Nærøyfjord
stops.caption: Boarding at 14:30 sharp. Two hours through the Nærøyfjord, which is on the UNESCO list and looks like it knows.

stops.name: Bergen
stops.subtitle: Torborg Nedreaas' gate
stops.caption: A five-minute walk to the E16, then the coach in from Gudvangen, arriving 19:25. Two days here, and a Bergen Card for both of them.

stops.name: Florø
stops.subtitle: Havila · port call
stops.caption: 02:45. Fifteen minutes alongside, and almost certainly asleep for it.

stops.name: Måløy
stops.subtitle: Havila · port call
stops.caption: 05:15. Fifteen minutes alongside.

stops.name: Torvik
stops.subtitle: Havila · port call
stops.caption: 08:20. Fifteen minutes alongside, and the light finally starting to come back.

stops.name: Ålesund
stops.subtitle: Havila · ten hours ashore
stops.caption: 09:45 to 20:00 — a whole day ashore in the art nouveau town the sea keeps giving back.

stops.name: Molde
stops.subtitle: Havila · port call
stops.caption: 22:35. Half an hour alongside, in the dark.

stops.name: Kristiansund
stops.subtitle: Havila · port call
stops.caption: 02:45, in the dark again. The rhythm of a working coast.

stops.name: Trondheim
stops.subtitle: Rosenborg gate
stops.caption: Ashore at 09:45 after breakfast on board. Nidaros Cathedral, the old bridge, and the painted streets of Bakklandet.

stops.name: Tromsø
stops.subtitle: Panorama Glass Lodge
stops.caption: A five o'clock bus, then Trondheim → Oslo → Tromsø, both legs before noon. Three hundred and fifty kilometres inside the Arctic Circle.
stops.arrivedBy: SAS SK341 and SK4414, via Oslo

stops.name: Her birthday
stops.subtitle: Under the glass roof
stops.caption: 23 November 2025. A glass lodge in Krokelvdalen, and whatever the sky decided to do that night.

stops.name: Rovaniemi
stops.subtitle: Nova Village Aurora Hut
stops.caption: Finnair at 10:25, across the top of Scandinavia and down into Lapland. A glass hut again, because once was not enough.

stops.name: Turku
stops.subtitle: Santa Claus Express
stops.caption: 17:52 to 07:33. Thirteen hours asleep on a train down the whole length of Finland, and awake again at the other end of it.
stops.arrivedBy: Santa Claus Express — overnight VR sleeper

stops.name: Stockholm
stops.subtitle: Overnight ferry
stops.caption: Sailed from Turku at 20:55, docked at 06:30, across the Baltic in the dark.

stops.name: Istanbul
stops.subtitle: Gümüşsuyu, Taksim
stops.caption: Pegasus out of Arlanda at 15:20. Three days on the way home, which is the best kind of three days.

stops.name: Baku
stops.subtitle: Heydar Aliyev
stops.caption: Azerbaijan Airlines, 12:20 to 16:10 — the last connection, and the last airport of seventeen days.

stops.name: Delhi
stops.subtitle: Home
stops.caption: Landed 03:25. Seventeen days, eleven ways of travelling, and one birthday under a glass roof.
